abstract: Here are reported the therapeutic results of ifosfamide on primary ovarian malignancies in 30 cases which were treated at Kurume University Hospital from September 1978 to December 1980. These cases were advanced or recurrent ones, and histologically, they consisted of serous cystadenocarcinoma in 22 cases, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma in 2, unclassified adenocarcinoma in 1, and malignant teratoma in 5. In the ifosfamide therapy, 2 grams or 40 mg/kg per day were given intravenously for 5 consecutive days, and as observing the blood state and the general condition, it was repeated every 3 weeks. The drug was given from 1 to 7 courses, and the average was 3.3 courses. The effect was evaluated by Koyama-Saito's criteria and Karnofsky's criteria; the response rate was 48% in the adenocarcinoma group and 20% in the malignant teratoma by the former criteria, while the rate was 64% and 20%, respectively, by the latter one. As main side effects, there were seen hemorrhagic cystitis, nausea and vomiting, and the myelotoxicity was low.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、1978年9月から1980年12月までに久留米大学病院で治療を受けた原発性卵巣悪性腫瘍30例に対するイホスファミドの治療成績を報告する。症例は進行例または再発例であり、組織学的には漿液性嚢胞腺癌22例、粘液性嚢胞腺癌2例、分類不能腺癌1例、悪性奇形腫5例であった。イホスファミド療法は1日2gまたは40mg/kgを5日間連日静脈内投与し、血液状態と全身状態を観察しながら3週ごとに反復した。投与は1～7コースで、平均3.3コースであった。効果判定は小山・斎藤の基準およびKarnofskyの基準で行い、前者では腺癌群48%、悪性奇形腫群20%、後者では64%および20%の奏効率であった。主な副作用は出血性膀胱炎、悪心・嘔吐であり、骨髄毒性は低かった。
